listings.description:
Size  
 Top-Shirt-Kurta : Length -  3.4  Metres, Width -  106  cm. Dupatta : Length -  236  cm, Width -  85  cm. Bottom : Length -  2.4  Metres, Width -  106  cm. 
 
 
  Weight  
 375 grams (approximately). 
 
 
  Material  
 This beige chanderi silk x mul cotton 3pc dress material set showcases exquisite lucknowi heavy chikankari embroidery. The lightweight and breathable mul Chanderi fabric offers exceptional comfort, making it an ideal choice for festive and cultural occasions. Adorned with intricate threadwork, the set includes a kurta, a beautifully embroidered dupatta, and a matching bottom fabric, reflecting the timeless charm and elegance of traditional craftsmanship. 
 
 
  Care  
 Gentle hand wash separately in cold water with mild/liquid detergents. Avoid soaking for too long. 
 
 
  Colour  
 Slight difference in colour from the visible product image is possible.

listings.description:
Size  
             Length - 240 cm , Width - 91 cm . 
         
         
              Weight  
             175 grams (approximately). 
         
         
              Material  
             Fine quality pochampally ikat weave cotton handloom dupatta from Telangana. Ikat is a dyeing technique used to pattern textiles that employs a resist dyeing process similar to tie-dye on either the warp or weft fibers prior to dyeing. Elevate your attire with this cultural masterpiece, perfect for adding a touch of heritage to any ensemble. Ikat has lovely patterns and are world famous for their extremely beautiful colors, texture and designs. Indian Ikat is always admired by the fashion designers around the world. 
             
         
         
              Care  
             Gentle hand wash separately in cold water with mild/liquid detergents. Avoid soaking for too long. 
         
         
              Colour  
             Slight difference in colour from the visible product image is possible.
